name: dashboard-showcase
description: Configurability section: a faded product screenshot ringed by floating tip cards and image orbs, with a closing line. Live: the `.ap-dashboard` section on every vertical page.

title_accent.description: Word inside the heading to paint with the brand gradient. Must appear in title.

background.description: Soft background image behind the section.

tips.description: Up to four floating cards, placed as in the design. Each: title; optional icon (URL), icon_svg (inline SVG), icon_alt, tone (violet, blue, green, yellow) and rows (each: title, sub, chip, chip_tone — em, in, lb, yl).

orbs.description: Up to eight circular cut-outs around the screenshot. Each: image; optional alt, tone (red, lb, yl, green, in) and zoom (percent, default 100).

checks.description: Tick-marked lines under the stage. Plain strings.

ctas.description: Buttons under the checks. Each: label, url. The first is solid, the rest outlined.
